AlphaPro is an open-source Android companion project for Sony full-frame and APS-C mirrorless photographers, focused on camera connectivity, location sync, and photo transfer workflows.
Special thanks to the AlphaGPS, sony_geotagging, and Freemote communities for their research into Sony mirrorless Bluetooth protocols and PTP/IP architecture.
